title: Noordveld Agentic E-Commerce: the end-to-end workflow
disclaimer: Demonstration data. Not real operational data.

scenes.title: Machine down.
scenes.vo: A forklift stops. Somewhere, a customer needs a part, and doesn't know its number.

scenes.title: Know the part? Buy it.
scenes.vo: If you know what you want, the Parts Store has the full catalogue: fitment, price and stock on every part.

scenes.title: Investigate. Verify.
scenes.vo: Parts Intelligence answers questions about the catalogue from the knowledge graph. Every answer shows its graph path, and its source.

scenes.title: Describe the need. The agent does the rest.
scenes.vo: Don't know the part? Describe the problem. The agent identifies the machine and the part, checks fitment and stock, compares fulfilment options, and recommends one.

scenes.title: One step to the cart.
scenes.vo: One step to the cart. Checkout walks through delivery, the dealer, availability and fulfilment, before anything is ordered.

scenes.title: Every order, tracked.
scenes.vo: Once it's placed, the order is tracked step by step: allocation, fulfilment, shipment and delivery.

scenes.title: One question. One answer.
scenes.vo: Or simply ask. The Commerce Assistant reads a mistyped word as the catalogue word, and says so. It recommends only a part that fits, has an approved source and is in stock, and shows what it rejected, and why.

scenes.title: The rules decide. The evidence shows why.
scenes.vo: Warranty is decided by rules, not by the AI. Every check, the installation, the dealer and the evidence sit right beside the verdict.

scenes.title:
Sea: 91 days.
Air: 6 days.
scenes.vo: A shipment from Japan is travelling by economy sea: leg one of four, due on the nineteenth of November. The recorded air route takes six days instead of ninety-one, at twelve thousand, six hundred and seventy-five euros, against two thousand, eight hundred and thirty-five. Every number comes from the route's own record.

scenes.title:
Air: 5 days.
Sea: 31 days.
scenes.vo: Even where nothing has shipped yet, it shows the routes the network records. Lagos: five days by air, or thirty-one by sea, labelled as potential routes, never as promises.

scenes.title: From need to fulfilment, and after.
scenes.vo: Find it. Buy it. Track it. Trust it. Agentic e-commerce, at Noordveld.
